# Sourdough starter feeding

Feed the starter every twelve hours when it lives on the counter, once a week when it lives
in the fridge. A healthy starter doubles within six hours of a feeding and smells mildly
sour, never like nail polish remover.

To revive a sluggish starter, discard all but a spoonful, feed it equal weights of flour and
warm water, and keep it somewhere around 26 degrees. Repeat twice a day until it doubles
again. See [[bread-baking-schedule]] for when to take some out for a loaf.
